title: 语言服务器能否为编码代理节省Token？一种测量方法与初步研究
summary: 本文首次量化了编码代理中语言服务器协议（LSP）语义检索与词法检索（grep）在Token效率上的差异。通过五臂消融实验，发现LSP在符号定位任务中增加6%-118%的Token消耗，在引用完整性任务中仅对最弱模型节省Token，且无法提升召回上限。建议采用自适应路由策略。
summary_en: This paper quantifies the token efficiency of LSP-based semantic retrieval versus lexical grep for coding agents. Through five-arm ablations, it finds LSP increases token usage by 6%-118% on symbol localization and only saves tokens for the weakest model on reference tasks, suggesting an adaptive router.
